mars_en_belier_est_dans_son_signe_de_pre: Mars in Aries is in its sign of preference and fully expresses its energy. You possess a dynamic, courageous, and enterprising temperament. When faced with challenges, your first instinct is to act quickly rather than wait. You enjoy taking initiatives and opening new paths. Your motivation often arises from competition, ambitious goals, and the desire to progress. You like to feel that you are moving forward and that your efforts yield tangible results. Your enthusiasm is contagious, and you often inspire others to take action. Your greatest quality lies in your courage. Even when circumstances are difficult, you find the strength to move forward and defend what you believe is right. You do not hesitate to take on challenges that others would deem too risky. However, your impulsiveness can sometimes lead you to act before you have thought things through sufficiently. By further developing your patience and planning ability, you will transform your remarkable energy into an even more effective and sustainable force.

However, your attachment to your habits can sometimes slow down necessary changes. mars_en_capricorne_est_l_une_des_positio: Mars in Capricorn is one of the most disciplined positions in the natal chart.
